Create ONE production sheet, 1536x1024, with EXACTLY FOUR separate complete modular cedar PRIVACY FENCE components in a strict2x2 quadrant grid. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside actual wooden silhouettes, hardware, and tiny tight contact shadows. No painted background, no checkerboard, no grass/plant/pot/rock/scenery/bird/person/text/label/border. Each component is centered inside its own quadrant with generous empty alpha clearance, no crossing quadrant boundaries or clipping.
The supplied TWO references are both internally generated project art: first the cedar feeder, second cedar lattice trellis. Use their naturalistic detailed wood texture, weathered warm cedar/silver-brown surface, upper-left warm daylight and subtle stepped pixel contours only. Do NOT copy the feeder, lattice pattern, posts-on-sled-bases, plants, scenery or support feet. Author a new coherent family of solid vertical-board cedar privacy fencing, calm enough that birds remain focus. Detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART with deliberate crisp square clusters; restrained woodgrain, small nail heads, minor believable weathering, subtle outlines. No smooth photographic airbrush, no bevel-heavy game UI or cartoon exaggeration.
CAMERA: mostly frontal rear yard-boundary view, slight right face and slight top visibility, shallow garden perspective. Keep verticals upright, upper rails nearly horizontal. All pieces share the same board width, rail/cap thickness, warm cedar palette, 1.8m privacy fence height, and projected image scale near160 native pixels per meter. Do NOT normalize each piece to fill its quadrant: fence infill width about320px and height288px; gate leaf width about160px and leaf height264-280px; standalone post narrow about22-30px wide and296px tall. Corner uses the same near288px board height. Leave at least80px free alpha around every component where feasible.
TOP LEFT: one complete straight TWO-METER cedar fence infill panel, ~320px wide and288px tall, solid closely fitted vertical cedar planks with narrow true-alpha seam gaps where there are actual gaps, two or three matching horizontal support rails behind, and one thin FLAT horizontal top cap/rail with visible upper surface. NO end posts, NO legs, NO broad ground slab, NO side frame. Both left and right board/rail ends exposed cleanly so they can align against separately authored posts. Panel floats at construction height without painted yard underneath. Its base is the lower wood edge, not a false soil mound.
TOP RIGHT: one matching ONE-METER CLOSED gate LEAF only, about160px wide and270px tall, fitted cedar vertical boards, a thin flat top rail and narrow perimeter cedar braces; subtle diagonal rear brace only if partly visible. Two dark metal hinges visibly attached on its left edge, simple dark latch on its right edge. NO gate-frame posts, NO arch, NO fence beyond gate, NO freestanding foot, NO ground shadow pretending the gate leaf stands on earth. It is a suspended leaf needing a future hinge support. Entire hardware fits within the quadrant. Static closed art only, no open gate pose.
BOTTOM LEFT: one complete L-shaped90-degree cedar corner fence component. Exactly ONE own flat-capped square corner post, with two short solid vertical-board fence wings meeting at that post at a visibly orthogonal right angle; each wing about1m long, matching the infill board/cap dimensions and privacy height. Slightly angled left/right faces are allowed to communicate the corner, but NO extra end posts at either exposed wing end, NO sprawling slab, no sled feet. Same cedar grain and narrow seam gaps; whole corner silhouette complete.
BOTTOM RIGHT: one SINGLE standalone narrow flat-capped cedar END POST, ~1.85m tall, ~0.14m square, about22-30px wide and296px tall at sharedscale; a simple FLAT square wood cap with slight top visibility, weathered warm cedar grain, no pointed/pyramidal finial, no lantern, no attached fence, no foot crossbar or large pedestal. Thin post bottom with tiny tight contact shadow only. Keep it much narrower than the gate or panel, no forced quadrant enlargement.
All four are static DRY LIGHTLY WEATHERED cedar candidates, no wet/glossy/snow/holiday variants and no motion effects. Full requested silhouettes with native alpha; no fake matte or diffuse radial halos.
